features.title: Personal comfort made for you
features.text: Sized for one, this sofa gives you a private spot to curl up with a book, a warm cup of tea, or a few quiet minutes of calm.

features.title: Pocket-spring seat for lasting bounce
features.text: Springs inside foam keep seating buoyant and fresh, so every sit feels supportive and never sinks, even after years of use.

features.title: Wide armrests for relaxed ease
features.text: Broad arms let you stretch out comfortably, giving you extra support whether you’re reading, scrolling, or just resting.

features.title: Refined stitching for elegant detail
features.text: Neat lines add a crafted look, making the sofa visually polished while staying inviting and homely.

features.title: Blue tone that lifts your décor
features.text: The vibrant shade adds personality and freshness, pairing beautifully with modern neutrals or bold accents.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
